No-text handling, recognition-highlight toggling, multi-image page navigation, Close/discard, and cold-relaunch discard are observed. Exact Copy Text serialization remains a nonblocking gap because the device-local clipboard payload was not exposed by the capture authority.

Fourteen behavior classes have representative evidence. Pitch matching, audible pronunciation and speech-source behavior, controlled offline/network behavior, and formal repeatability remain blocked with exact owners and resume procedures.

A new controlled taberu baseline was attempted from empty Search, but iPhone Mirroring paused before a settled result and did not reconnect; the shell was not retained as product evidence and no runtime behavior was inferred.

Camera and Photo Library source mechanics are excluded from this discovery revision under the stakeholder's explicit scope decision; the private-access Photo picker was opened and cancelled without retaining any personal content.

All nine AirDropped synthetic fixture files were moved to Files Recently Deleted after capture, the failed Mac staging folder was moved to Trash, no permissions were changed, and Nihongo was restored to the empty Search root.
App-level semantic accessibility capture remains unavailable through the proven tools; the limitation and fallback are recorded in tool-access-plan.json.

The installed build directly names CJK Dictionary Institute plus UniDic for pitch accent, English Wiktionary with Japanese Wiktionary and Shinjigen for etymology, and Google plus OCR.space as online OCR choices; Google was selected during capture.

The displayed On Device OCR option remains unnamed and explicitly lacks vertical-text support. The installed Voice screen confirms human-recording fallback to configured system voices but does not identify the current human-audio providers or exact speech API.

Source provenance capture retained seven privacy-reviewed screenshots, recorded eight displayed source/provider entries, crosswalked every required capability to a verified source, inference, or stable gap, and restored Nihongo to the empty Search root.

Fifteen provenance gap groups remain, including four licensing blockers. Each has an owner, affected capability, completed independent work, and reproducible resume procedure in source-provenance.json.

The reference-resource crosswalk represents all 83 recursive state nodes, 129 action edges, 35 fixture classes, and 19 language-behavior claims exactly once and binds them to the pinned authority, environment, scope, journeys, fixtures or preconditions, evidence, resource provenance, and atomic-ledger disposition.

Crosswalk integrity passes with zero duplicate IDs, unresolved surface references, missing evidence paths, manifest hash mismatches, or unresolved blocker IDs. The preliminary stroke-order identifier and stale surface counts were reconciled to the recursive crawl.

The crosswalk is complete as an index but not coding-ready: 32 distinct inherited or newly specified blocker IDs remain. Quantified design measurements and exact UI-glyph asset identity/licensing are newly explicit gap groups; no proprietary or paid asset was copied.
